recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: circadian clocks measured against skylight instead of bedside alarms
pair-programming ghosts mapping corridors inside enormous codebases
solo builders pinning audit timelines beside playful side projects
clear coastal spring midnight, thermometer parked in sweater weather
pocket automations humming while public posts stay quiet ashore

composer-2-fast.concept: Ride quantized 'stutter' beat windows across a night's worth of commuter UI—each snapped hit locks a luminous panel before the waveform smears.
composer-2-fast.mechanic: Rhythm taps on drifting pulse halos that shrink and phase-offset each loop.
composer-2-fast.touch_control: Single-thumb tap timed to transient blooms on a horizontal rave strip.
composer-2-fast.session_hook: Perfect chains saturate color until a bonus breakdown lane peels open like a cassette flip.
composer-2-fast.escalation: Ghost echoes duplicate targets; BPM inches up until double-taps are mandatory on shadow beats.
composer-2-fast.aesthetic: CRT-misted night-bus interior with RMS meters scaffolding the skyline.

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Sweep a thumb-light cone over a drifting field of holographic serif glyphs; ignite matching pairs before they oxidize gray.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.mechanic: Timed radial sweeps tagging twin symbols amid rotating spawn vectors.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.touch_control: Drag to steer a translucent spotlight, lift to hop it to a new anchor.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: Each valid pair pulls a spring vine along the phone bezel like a progress ribbon.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: Wind shear tilts spawns; duplicate silhouettes force quick re-aim before timeout.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: Matte Pacific fog gradients with chrome caption fragments.

claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.concept: Play a pocket 'shortcut chord chart': memorize expanding glyph sequences with prime-number branch nodes that fork the pattern tree.
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.mechanic: Pattern memory with optional branch taps that alter the next segment.
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.touch_control: Sequential lane taps; long-press on fork diamonds to pick alternate paths.
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.session_hook: Clean branches draw thin wires from handset silhouette to a tiny cloud glyph.
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.escalation: Chromatic blur masks early steps; phantom nodes flicker on off-beats.
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.aesthetic: Bauhaus telegram forms with cobalt ink bleed and paper tooth.

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Flick dew beads along tensioned silk lines between imagined pier railings; split mid-arc to thread two spring buds at once.
gemini-3.1-pro.mechanic: Slingshot flick plus mid-air split to multi-target collision puzzles on one screen.
gemini-3.1-pro.touch_control: Pull-back aim and release; secondary tap cleaves the droplet mid-flight.
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: A perfect split blooms both targets simultaneously, freezing crosswind for one beat.
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: Crosswinds curve shots; barbs appear that punish greedy straight lines.
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: Macro photo glass fused with chalk-pastel botanical highlights.
